name: goey-toaster
title: Gooey Toaster
description: Morphing blob toast notifications with organic pill-to-blob animations, promise tracking, and full customization.
author: anl331 (https://github.com/anl331)
docs:
## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://goey-toast.vercel.app/r/goey-toaster.json
```

## Usage

Add the `<GooeyToaster />` component to your root layout:

```tsx
import { GooeyToaster } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster"

export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html>
      <body>
        {children}
        <GooeyToaster />
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

Then trigger toasts anywhere:

```tsx
import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster"

gooeyToast.success("Saved!")
gooeyToast.error("Something went wrong")
gooeyToast.promise(fetchData(), {
  loading: "Loading...",
  success: "Done!",
  error: "Failed",
})
```

## Theming

The installed wrapper maps goey-toast's public CSS variables (`--gooey-fill`, `--gooey-border`, `--gooey-title-*`, `--gooey-description`, ...) to your shadcn tokens (`--popover`, `--popover-foreground`, `--muted-foreground`, `--border`, ...), so toasts follow the `.dark` class automatically. No `theme` prop is needed. Edit the `GOOEY_SHADCN_CSS` block in the installed file to change the mapping.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| position | `top-left` \| `top-center` \| `top-right` \| `bottom-left` \| `bottom-center` \| `bottom-right` | `bottom-right` | Toast position |
| duration | `number` | — | Default display duration (ms) |
| gap | `number` | `14` | Gap between toasts (px) |
| offset | `number \| string` | `24px` | Distance from edge |
| theme | `light` \| `dark` \| `system` | `system` | Color scheme used by the built-in colors. The shadcn mapping above already follows `.dark` |
| closeButton | `boolean \| 'top-left' \| 'top-right'` | `false` | Show close button on hover |
| closeOnEscape | `boolean` | `true` | Dismiss the most recent toast on Escape |
| swipeToDismiss | `boolean` | `true` | Swipe a toast away to dismiss it |
| showProgress | `boolean` | `false` | Show a countdown progress bar on all toasts |
| showTimestamp | `boolean` | `true` | Show timestamps on all toasts |
| spring | `boolean` | `true` | Enable spring/bounce animations globally |
| bounce | `number` | `0.4` | Spring intensity: `0.05` (subtle) to `0.8` (dramatic) |
| preset | `smooth` \| `bouncy` \| `subtle` \| `snappy` | — | Animation preset for all toasts |
| dir | `ltr` \| `rtl` | `ltr` | Text direction |
| visibleToasts | `number` | `3` | Max toasts visible at once |
| maxQueue | `number` | `Infinity` | Max toasts waiting in the queue |
| queueOverflow | `drop-oldest` \| `drop-newest` | `drop-oldest` | Behavior when the queue is full |

See [full documentation](https://goey-toast.vercel.app) for all options.
